limits: Track matching applies a constant speed ratio only inside one constant-BPM zone; it does not align beat phase or track a changing tempo automatically.
Pitch comparison and BPM detection are estimates; the user must review them. Real complex music has not been validated.
Sample editor history uses project session undo/redo and consolidates edited track segments into a new source clip.
Native zoom behavior on actual Windows/macOS/Linux/Android/iOS devices is not verified here.
